item.title: MCP Gateway 1/3: Why every enterprise rolling out MCP needs a gateway
item.description: A walk-through of an open, MIT-licensed reference MCP gateway built on FastMCP, OPA and Microsoft Entra ID — why an enterprise MCP rollout needs a single control point, and what that control point has to do.
